description: This file is a Perl test script using Test2::V0 framework to test user email change and password recovery functionalities in a web application. It performs various form submissions, email verifications, and database state checks related to user email change process.

classes.name: Test2::V0
classes.description: Test2::V0 is a Perl testing framework used for writing the test scripts.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: Test::Coocook is a custom testing class used for testing user account functionalities such as email change and password recovery.

methods.name: cols_are_null
methods.description: Checks that specific user columns related to email change and tokens are null, indicating no pending changes.

methods.name: cols_are_set
methods.description: Checks that specific user columns related to tokens are set, indicating active change requests.
